stance: Consumer sentiment is weak: 48.1 in September after 51.7 in August, 3.6 points lower and close to the May 2026 record low of 44.8. Soft sentiment tends to foreshadow softer retail spending, but the two decouple often, so we wait for hard spending data. No inflation expectations data logged yet this cycle. Stance: cautious, bearish lean on consumer, low conviction. A rebound above 52 or firm retail sales would soften the view.
